description: Sprinting hits that slow the attacker: a fist on a boat with sprint held (the sprint resumes) and a weaker hit after it; a sword on a minecart after a double-tapped sprint (the sprint ends); a sword on a zombie (the client doesn't slow; the server ends the sprint); two clicks at the sky in one tick and the attack key held there; a spear jab refused before it is charged, then made.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

build: item replace entity @a hotbar.1 with minecraft:diamond_sword
item replace entity @a hotbar.2 with minecraft:wooden_spear
harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
